classification: Four distinct paired printing-face profiles, Nos.18/19/22/23. Interior segments preserve relative stroke widths and separation; cropped boundaries are not claimed as isolated source terminals. No24 is an additional witness of the existing Jobroom6-point profile E23A.
comparison: Native half-depth widths and grayscale centroids at20/50/80 percent of each run, supported by uniform native-detail comparisons at equal line-centre spacing. Neither run length nor nominal metal-body size establishes identity.
sampling: Fourfold bilinear sampling of the retained native context, followed by local paper normalization at48 sample pixels. Sampling adds no source detail. The tracing crop selects a complete two-stroke interior segment from the continuous construction.

additional_witnesses.context_review: All fifteen native face/body compositions and both terminal/boundary contexts reviewed. Draft boxes retain caption or attached-body context; refine before isolated tracing. No new assignment from body width alone.
additional_witnesses.name: Unequal double rule, 6-point
additional_witnesses.reason: The upper/lower half-depth widths relative to centre separation closely agree with the existing Job Room6-point profile at all three measured positions. The8-point metal-body caption denotes this witness, not a separate construction. This is a profile correspondence, not a claim of shared metal stock.
additional_witnesses.quality_selection: Retain the sharper Job Room drawing; the Document impression has softer edges and more uneven upper-band ink.
